verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say its PR review surfaces issues that matter and are ranked by severity, avoids low-signal feedback, reviews the full codebase rather than just the diff, and catches breaking changes that diff-only tools miss. They also describe weighting findings by how the team handled similar ones in past PRs. However, nothing explicitly documents detecting logic errors, race conditions or broken edge cases, and there is no hands-on evidence of review accuracy. missing for 10: explicit documentation of logic-error/concurrency/edge-case detection, independent or hands-on corroboration that the reviewer catches real bugs rather than nits.
